methodology.null_handling: trait-wise abstention as amp.evaluate; conditional metrics exclude null, accuracy_all counts null incorrect
methodology.permutations: 1000 random shuffles; seed 20261128; +1 correction; one-sided positive and two-sided; repeated trajectories are dependent, use one-person results for inference
methodology.rank_calibration: floor(5*(zero_based_average_rank+0.5)/n), capped at 4; ties never split; not exact equal-frequency if ties span bins; calibrated on evaluated sample, not held out
methodology.pooled_warning: Raw values pooled across traits are not normalized and may reflect between-trait scale differences; per-trait results take precedence.
methodology.one_person_selection: lexically latest experiment, then lexically first run; label-blind; no best-of selection
methodology.baseline: per dataset/trait train majority; lower level wins ties; same covered pairs for comparison
methodology.scope: Train primary; Dev supplementary; unscorable RecruitView person targets never inherit answer labels
